steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow the buyer to add vendors during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Apply an auction template before adding line items.
Add the auction item to quote.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.

args.goal: on the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop on the create screen showing the saved terms configuration

steps.note: Configure the event-level/stage-level clauses and their requiredness, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the required clause is visible after saving the terms.
Verify the optional clause is visible after saving the terms.
Invite one QA test vendor to the auction.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's auction bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Accept only the optional clause, leaving the required clause unchecked.
Attempt submission with only the optional clause accepted; the bid must be blocked.
Verify the refusal identifies or highlights the required clause.
Accept the required clause after the blocked submission.
Submit the bid with both clauses accepted and a quote of 100.
Confirm the vendor bid was successfully submitted.
